hooks.command: git -C "$PWD" diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '(firestore\.rules|\.env\.local|next\.config\.ts|lib/firebase-admin\.ts|app/api/)' && echo '{"systemMessage": "Reminder: if you changed Firebase config, env vars, API routes, or security rules — update SETUP.md to keep the manual setup guide current."}' || true

{ git -C "$PWD" diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null; git -C "$PWD" diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD 2>/dev/null; } | sort -u | grep -vE '^(CHANGELOG\.md|\.claude/|.*\.md)$' | grep -q . && echo '{"systemMessage": "CHANGELOG reminder: code changes detected this session. Update CHANGELOG.md before ending — one line per meaningful change, grouped by: Features, Security, Bug Fixes, Legal, Infrastructure."}' || true

echo '{"systemMessage": "Before compacting: review what was worked on this session and surface 2-3 specific improvement suggestions for the FiTEN directory (UI quality, data gaps, dead code, missing features). Be concrete — file names and line numbers where relevant."}'
